facts.text: Serve the mains at Roger's birthday dinner, when Riggs meets the family.
facts.why: Murtaugh has just turned fifty, but none of the pages I could open describe a birthday dinner or Riggs first meeting the family. The only family dinner they describe is Christmas Day at the end, after Riggs visits his wife's grave. The printed cue and the data cue are the same line.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Riggs sits down with the Murtaughs on Christmas Day.

facts.why: Same problem as the cue. Murtaugh turning fifty is true, but a birthday dinner is not described in any source I could open. Christmas Day dinner is.
No source I opened has Riggs staying in the Murtaugh guest room. The film has him living in his trailer and joining the family for Christmas Day dinner.

vibe.verdict: Right family kitchen and Christmas feel, but it never reaches for the film's best-known moments.

Swap 'Riggs' trailer snacks' note for 'A beer and a biscuit for Sam, dinner for one'.
Rename 'Christmas party crab dip' to 'Christmas tree lot crab dip' to use the opening sting.
